practices.practice: Prefer Microsoft Entra ID (managed identity / RBAC) and Key Vault for production authentication rather than account keys, and rotate or avoid long-lived keys in production.

practices.practice: Tune connection-pool parameters (maxPoolSize / maxConnectionsPerEndpoint, maxIdleTimeMS, idleEndpointTimeout) for your SDK or driver to match expected concurrency and host limits.

practices.practice: Set sensible client timeouts (serverSelectionTimeoutMS, connectTimeoutMS, socketTimeoutMS) and cap query execution with maxTimeMS so operations fail fast rather than hang indefinitely.
practices.prior_belief: Set sensible timeouts (serverSelectionTimeoutMS, connectTimeoutMS, socketTimeoutMS) so application requests fail fast on network issues instead of hanging indefinitely.

practices.practice: Implement retries with exponential backoff for transient errors and be careful about idempotency; the service examples often set retryWrites=false and explain safe retry semantics.
practices.prior_belief: Enable and implement exponential-backoff retries for transient errors (with idempotency for writes) and consider enabling driver retryWrites if supported by the cluster.

practices.practice: Use bulk write/bulk upsert or SDK bulk execution when ingesting large datasets rather than many single upserts to reduce round trips and improve throughput.
practices.prior_belief: Use bulkWrite / bulk upsert for seeding and large ingest operations rather than many single upserts to reduce round-trips and improve throughput.

practices.practice: Keep documents small and bounded (respect the 16 MB BSON/document limit); store large assets (images, PDFs) externally and keep only metadata and embeddings in the document.
practices.prior_belief: Keep documents small and bounded (well under the 16MB MongoDB document limit); for product catalogs, store assets externally (CDN/blob) and only keep metadata + embeddings in the document.

practices.practice: Create and maintain a BM25 full-text search index using createSearchIndexes (set mappings.dynamic:false and enumerate fields), then use $search as the first aggregation stage and project searchScore with { $meta: 'searchScore' }.

practices.practice: Create and tune a vector index using the appropriate kind (vector-hnsw, vector-ivf, or vector-diskann) and set tuning parameters (e.g., m / efConstruction for HNSW, numLists for IVF, lBuild / lSearch / maxDegree / product quantization for DiskANN) and choose the similarity metric.
practices.prior_belief: Create or configure a vector index using the cluster's supported index type (DiskANN/HNSW/IVF) and tune core parameters (e.g., M, efConstruction/efSearch, metric) appropriate to dimensionality and latency/accuracy tradeoffs.

practices.practice: Store embeddings as fixed-length numeric arrays (number[]) with consistent dimensionality and, when using cosine similarity, use normalized (unit-length) vectors to make scores comparable.

practices.practice: Fuse BM25 and vector ranked lists with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) or do server-side fusion (eg. $unionWith + $group) when you want a single fused ranking.

practices.practice: For frequent filter+sort patterns, create compound indexes that match the query predicate and sort order (ESR rule) to avoid collection scans and in-memory sorts.
practices.prior_belief: For common filter + sort query patterns create compound indexes that match the query's predicate and sort order to avoid collection scans (e.g., {category:1, price:1}).

practices.practice: Use projections (find/aggregation $project) to return only the fields needed (for example, exclude embeddings by default) to reduce network IO and payload size.

practices.practice: Avoid deep paging with large skip values; implement seek-based (bookmark) pagination or use continuation tokens instead of skip/limit to avoid heavy cost of skip.
